Page 001
001-1. junitius  Nyanism njunitius junitius RP CL/RD TS TL
001-2. Paragon Scans
001-3. discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx

Page 002
002-1. GOOD MORNING AUNTIE.
002-2. DECIDED TO STILL CALL HER AUNTIE IN THE END
002-3. YOU'RE HERE, TAKE A SEAT.
002-4. MOM, WHERE'S DAD?
002-5. YET ANOTHER BURIAL SITE REQUIRES HIS HELP IN RESEARCHAND EMERGENCY PRESERVATION, SO HE'S OUT TRAVELING FOR WORK.HE WON'T BE HOME FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF DAYS.

Page 003
003-1. SIGH, HE'S NOT HERE...
003-2. I WANTED JIANG HE TO CALL HIM DAD TO OBSERVE HIS REACTION, THOUGH IN THE END JIANG HE WASN'T ABLE TO DO IT, AND HE ISN'T AT HOME.
003-3. MY PHONE IS OUT OF BATTERY AGAIN...
003-4. WHY AREN'T PHONES DESIGNED WITH A REMOVABLE BATTERY?
003-5. JUST LIKE A FLASHLIGHT, WHERE YOU CAN USE IT AFTER THE STUFFING BATTERY IN.

Page 004
004-1. 于火中，不认发品##电机，免 置手过过、性 生产日期：2012年11月 SN8AK121117302 (TAOOU Us3rV 200p 健子充电电池 型号：T2W9721 电权电42V 行标准G8/T8287-2000 北京天中通货设备股份机限公司 北京市州区中天村局园 电一体党产业地嘉创二路1号
004-2. ACTLALLY, PHONES USED TO COME WITH RE- MOVABLEBATTERIES BEFORE IT WAS CHAN- GED TO THEIR CLR- RENT STATE.
004-3. YOU CAN USE YOUR PHONE TO SEARCH FOR THE REASON IF YOU WANT TOKNOW WANT TO KNOW WHY.
004-4. SHE'LL LEARN HOW TO DISCOVER AND SOLVE PROBLEMS BY HERSELF EVENTUALLY, ANDSHECAN'T MAKEITAHABITTOASKME ABOUT IT ALLTHE TIME.
004-5. 'DON'T YOU KNOW HOW TO GOOGLE?" WORDS LIKE THOSE ARE ESPECIALLY HURTFUL, BUT IF SHE GETS USED TO RECEIVING HANDOUTS, IT WOULD DO NO GOOD FOR HER PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT.
004-6. 快快看
004-7. I'LL LEND YOU MY PHONE.

Page 005
005-1. YOU CAN SEARCH FOR IT FIRST, I'LL BE IN THE STUDY LOOK- ING AT SOME BOOKS.
005-2. AND THE THING I SHOULD DO NOW IS TO LET HER GO.
005-3. WHAT SHOULD I READ TO PASS THE TIME...
005-4. WAIT,
005-5. The History of Empress Wu Zetian
005-6. ISN'T THIS!?
005-7. T/N: Wu Zetian was the only female empress of China and is widely considered as one of the greater rulers in Chinese history.
005-8. IT'S TIME TO EAT!

Page 006
006-1. COMING~!
006-2. HERE'S YOUR PHONE BACK.
006-3. WOAH, SHE EVEN CHANGED MY WALLPAPER, THAT WAS QUICK!
006-4. WHAT SHENANIGANS WERE YOU UP TO IN THE STUDY JUST NOW?

Page 007
007-1. WHAT DO YOU MEAN BY SHENANIGANS? I WAS DOING RESEARCH ON HISTORY AND TRYING TO UNDERSTAND THE HERITAGE OFOUR PEOPLE.
007-2. 快！快看
007-3. YOu, OFALL PEOPLE?
007-4. WHAT DO YOU MEAN BY THAT, LOVING ANTIQUES RUNS IN THE BLOOD OF THE MIGHTY XU FAMILY!
007-5. LOOK AT XU XIAN, WHOLIKED A THOUSAND YEAR OLD SPIRIT; MY DAD, WHO LIKES THOUSAND YEAR OLD BURIAL SITES; AND ME...HEHE.
007-6. T/N: Xu Xian is a main character in the Legend of the White Snake, where he falls in love with a white snake spirit.

Page 008
008-1. THIS GUY IS DOING IT AGAIN!
008-2. *pinch*
008-3. STOP SPOUTING NONSENSE ALL DAY LONG OR YOU'LL LEAD JIANG HE ASTRAY.
008-4. JIANG HE, THE WEATHER HAS BEEN WARM RECENTLY, YOU SHOULD EAT MOREBITTER GOURD FOR ITS COOLINGPROPERTIES.YOU SHOLLD EAT IT MORE OFTEN ATHOME ASWELLAND CUT DOWN ON THE OILY FOODS.
008-5. 快租快看
008-6. YOU SHOULD SOAK THEM IN SALTED WATER BEFORE STIR FRYING THEM, AND IT WILL BE LESS BITTER...
008-7. AREN'T YOU SUPPOSED TO EAT BITTER GOURDS FOR ITS BIT- TERNESS?
008-8. AIYA...

Page 009
009-1. SHE'S RIGHT, IF YOU DON'T WANT THE BITTERNESS, YOU SHOULD JUST BLY AND COOK CUCLMBERS INSTEAD.
009-2. MOM,SHE KNOWS HOW TO COOK MORE DISHES THANYOU DO NOW. SHE CONSTANTLY RESEARCHES ONHOWTO COOK TASTY DISHES FOR ME AND EVEN LEARNS THEM REALLY FAST.
009-3. WHAT CAN YOU EVEN DO? EAT YOUR FOOD!
009-4. I UNDERSTAND IT NOW, THIS RASCAL ONLY BRINGS HIS GIRLFRIENDHOMETOSHOW HER OFF EVERYTIME, AND I'MTHE ONE HE'S SHOWING OFF TO WHEN HIS DAD IS NOT AROUND.

Page 010
010-1. DON'T MESS UP YOUR DAD'S STUDY, OR HE WILL FLIP OUT AT YOU WHEN HE'S BACK.
010-2. I WON'T I WON'T, I'LL PUIT THE BOOKS BACKWHEN I'M DONE WITH THEM. I DON'T HAVE THE HABIT OF LEAVING THEM AROLND.
010-3. I DIDN'T EXPECT DAD TO HAVE DONE RESEARCH ON THIS, CONSIDERING HOW REFINED HE IS.
010-4. T/N: Wu Zetian was a prom- iscuous figure, with acts such as marrying her stepson.

Page 011
011-1. ALL ARE THESE BOOKS OVER HERE ON HISTORY?
011-2. 快卧！ 快
011-3. YUP, FEEL FREE TO READ ANY OF THEM IF yOU WANT.
011-4. Book of Tang
011-5. YOU MUST REMEMBER TO PUT IT BACK AFTER YOU'RE DONE WITH iT THOUGH, OR MY DAD WON'T BE ABLE TO FIND IT WHEN HE WANTS TO READ IT.
011-6. THIS FEELS WEIRD,

Page 012
012-1. 武则天野史
012-2. Apho Mitheruc
012-3. I'M LEARNING ALL THERE IS ABOUT THE MODERNWORLD, WHILE HE'S DOINGTHE SAME ABOUTANCIENT HISTORY.

Page 013
013-1. OH MY,THOSE TWO ARE STICKING SO CLOSE TO EACHOTHER!
013-2. I SHOULD STOP LOOKING, IT'S TOO SPICY FOR MY EYES.

Page 014
014-1. W 武则天 快看 快租！
014-2. W-WHYARE YOU READING STUFF LIKE THIS?
014-3. THIS IS SERIOUS HISTORICAL RESEARCH, PLEASE DO NOT LOOK AT IT WITH PREJUDICE.
014-4. DO YOU THINK THAT I'LL BELIEVE YOUR NONSENSE?

Page 015
015-1. I WAS HAPPY BECAUSE I THOUGHT THAT HE WAS SERIOUSLY LEARNING ABOUT HISTORY, BUT IT TURNS OUT HE WAS READING ABOUT STUFF LIKE THIS!
015-2. HOW IS IT NONSENSE?
015-3. DO YOU KNOW WHAT A BOY TOY IS?
015-4. IT'S.IT'S.
015-5. ICEBOUND

Page 016
016-1. HOW CAN I TALK ABOUT SUCH INDECENT THINGS?!
016-2. DENG TUZI!

Page 017
017-1. I hope you enjoyed today's chapter. Thank you for reading and see you next time.
017-2. To catch the next chapter at the earliest time possible, join our discord at discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx to be alerted when it's scanlated.
